cores.name: AI Task Scheduler Core
cores.description: AI Task Scheduler Core integration core for Tater.

cores.name: Automation Core
cores.description: Build simple event-to-action automations from Tater's shared integration categories, device actions, notifications, announcement targets, camera image or video descriptions, and optional Face ID-aware greetings using Tater's shared People profiles.

cores.name: Awareness Core
cores.description: Choose which cameras and sensors Tater should observe, describe camera events from images or short video clips, optionally pair sensors with cameras, retain their bounded event history, snapshots, and playable clips, answer questions about past activity, and optionally deliver the completed event with media and Face ID context. Face profiles are managed in Settings › People › Faces. Use Automation Core for custom notification text, announcements, and device actions.

cores.name: Environment Core
cores.description: AI-interpreted weather orchestration across local sensors, configured providers, forecasts, and named-place lookups.

cores.name: Guardian Core
cores.description: Network guardian core for device inventory, change detection, security analysis, and health monitoring.

cores.name: Memory Core
cores.description: Continuous semantic and episodic memory with profile cards, temporal corrections, on-demand recall, and bounded background extraction.

cores.name: Meshtastic Core
cores.description: Run Meshtastic chat, history, node status, Bluetooth discovery, and secure pairing through a transport-neutral Tater core.

cores.name: Music Core
cores.description: Connect Tater Tube Server to Tater; browse music, build AI-named recommendations from listening history, and keep voice-controlled queues playing with a smart continuous-radio refill across clock-synchronized satellites, native Sonos groups, stereo pairs, and media players.

cores.name: Personal Core
cores.description: Personal Core integration core for Tater.

cores.name: Reachy Core
cores.description: Control Reachy Tater Satellite and Reachy Tater Embedded behavior directly from Tater, including tracking, motion, music reactions, vision, head leveling, Idle Life, and Face ID greetings backed by Tater People.

cores.name: RSS Core
cores.description: RSS Core integration core for Tater.

cores.name: Tater Tube Core
cores.description: Connect Tater to Tater Tube Server, keep Tater's Picks focused on the server catalog, explain each pick and the group as a whole, create a separate global Main Menu Message from cross-module activity, voice both with the user's TTS settings, and play the server's video library on compatible Tater screens and same-room TVs.
